purpose: Public schema and holdout-boundary fixtures. They do not contain raw holdout prompts or labels.

fixtures.selector: Treat a similar catalog title or directory membership as a product/release upgrade.
fixtures.reason: Existing product/release anchors stay source-native. Title similarity and directory membership cannot upgrade them.

fixtures.selector: Promote a GIS-friendly redistribution to the product representative.
fixtures.reason: C1 related_candidates remain inference-only; they are not extra products or release bindings.

fixtures.selector: Score R07 against the 3,434 catalog record IDs.
fixtures.reason: The 3,434 IDs are catalog accounting, not a retrieval relevance denominator.

fixtures.selector: Treat the 40 retrieval tasks as the R14 scientific-claim gold set.
fixtures.reason: R14 requires a later independent claim frame from PR-020 residual evidence. The 40 tasks are an R07 input freeze.

fixtures.selector: Copy raw holdout questions, answer IDs, or private labels into tasks.json or Git.
fixtures.reason: Holdout labels remain inaccessible to implementer tuning. Public contract is the opaque task index plus hash of the sealed manifest.

fixtures.selector: Improve a metric by deleting a difficult cohort member, task, or selected pilot ID.
fixtures.reason: Original denominators are fixed. Unavailable or unresolved members stay in the denominator.

fixtures.selector: Use model agreement or implementer consensus as gold labels.
fixtures.reason: Independent blind judgments are required. Uncertainty blocks acceptance.

fixtures.selector: Mark the R14 denominator frozen because this protocol exists.
fixtures.reason: A protocol is not a materialized residual frame, sample, or label freeze.

fixtures.selector: Adopt the illustrative 149 iid count as an R14 sample-size or CI threshold.
fixtures.reason: The 149-observation illustration is not an adopted threshold.

fixtures.selector: Substitute a hospital price-transparency enforcement dataset for a selected rate file.
fixtures.reason: R10 parsed-sample targets cannot be met by enforcement datasets.

fixtures.selector: Treat a HIOS issuer or QIS workbook row as proof of a TiC reporting entity or file.
fixtures.reason: Issuer identity is a selected candidate. File locators remain unresolved until PR-049.

fixtures.selector: Treat CMS certification as state facility licensure evidence.
fixtures.reason: State facility licensure requires a state authority.

fixtures.selector: Treat a secondary APCD directory as the APCD source family.
fixtures.reason: Secondary directories are navigation only.

fixtures.selector: Treat HHS ASPE SVI (ypqf-r5qs) or a similar SVI title as CDC/ATSDR SVI.
fixtures.reason: Similar baseline SVI titles do not prove the exact CDC/ATSDR family.

fixtures.selector: Join facility identity by CCN=NPI or name-only equality.
fixtures.reason: Those shortcuts are forbidden matches and unsupported join routes.

fixtures.selector: Treat a published hospital charge or negotiated rate as a patient expected bill or utilization-weighted payment.
fixtures.reason: Price-definition negatives are in the public contract; they are critical forbidden matches for R07.

fixtures.selector: Substitute infant mortality evidence for a maternal-mortality intention.
fixtures.reason: Maternal versus infant mortality is a named public negative-case type.

fixtures.selector: Treat HCRIS and PHC4 as interchangeable hospital-finance grains.
fixtures.reason: HCRIS/PHC4 is a named public negative-case type; reporting scopes differ.

fixtures.selector: Satisfy R12 or R15 with generated participants, dates, or simulated cycles.
fixtures.reason: R12 needs actual participants. R15 needs two actual scheduled cycles and 14 actual elapsed days.

fixtures.selector: Call a paid product model from this metadata freeze.
fixtures.reason: Paid enrichment requires a selected product budget and credentials. This commit makes no model calls.
